sections.title: Letter sound
paragraphs: This letter is called (S) /z/. Its main sound is heard in the word (sun) /sʌn/, which means the star that gives light to Earth. This letter can make four different sounds in English words.

sections.title: How to say it
paragraphs: First, bring your tongue tip close behind your top front teeth. Blow air out without using your voice. Second, keep the same mouth shape, but turn your voice on. Feel your throat shake. Third, pull your tongue back a bit, round your lips and blow softly. Last, drop the sound completely and say nothing.

sections.title: Spelling rules
paragraphs: You hear the first sound at the start of a word, as in (cats) /kæts/. You hear the second sound between vowels, as in (busy) /bɪ.zi/, or after voiced sounds, as in (dogs) /dɒɡz/. You hear the third sound before unstressed vowels, as in (sugar) /ʃʊɡ.ə/. The letter is silent in special words, such as (island) /aɪ.lənd/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not confuse the voiced sound with the voiceless sound. Put a hand on your throat. When you make the buzzing sound, your throat must vibrate. When you make the hissing sound, your throat must stay still.
